highlights: Adjust brightness to low, medium, or high, and switch between warm white, natural white, or white light.

faq.question: How do I adjust the light settings?
faq.answer: Lightly touch the button to adjust brightness between low, medium, and high, and to turn the light on/off. Long press the button to cycle through the three color temperatures: warm white (2700K), natural white (4000K), and white light (5700K).

faq.question: How long does the battery last?
faq.answer: A full charge takes less than 4 hours and can provide up to 20 hours of light on the lowest setting, or up to 6 hours on the maximum brightness setting.

faq.question: How is this light installed?
faq.answer: Installation is tool-free; it uses a 3M adhesive for mounting. The light head can also be removed from the magnetic base for use as a portable flashlight.
